plan.title: Recreate Order rejects past delivery date

steps.note: Open the prepared live RFQ without creating or searching for another event.
Enable eRFX projects as required by the case.
Apply the requested live-event withdrawal configuration.
Reach the RFQ Responses tab before opening its Settings menu.
Open the Recreate Order window from the RFQ stage Settings menu.
Verify that the Recreate Order window opened.

args.goal: In the Recreate Order window, check the "Schedule this event?" checkbox, set Delivery Date to yesterday, click "Create Order", and stop with the window still open showing the inline validation error for a delivery date in the past; record the exact error wording.

steps.note: Perform the schedule interaction and observe the rejection, which no catalog action can otherwise complete.
Assert that the Recreate Order window remains open after the rejected submission.
